scientific_integrity: The underlying Laurent norms, weighted Szegő kernel and kernel-zero criterion are prior work. The new statement is the complete positive selfcommutator spectrum, sharp multiplicity phases, norm range and correspondence with the known kernel-zero criterion; finite exact checks supplement, but do not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only round annuli, positive constant boundary-circle weights and coordinate multiplier; no result for arbitrary weights, perturbed boundaries, or other multipliers. Priority is provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
title: Parity-split spectral multiplicities and sharp norm envelope for annular Hardy selfcommutators
